title: A remark on rational quartic curves in prime Fano threefolds of degree $22$
summary: In this short note, using the Sarkisov link between a prime Fano threefold $V_{22}$ of degree $22$ and the quintic del Pezzo threefold $V_5$, we prove that the Hilbert scheme of rational quartic curves in $V_{22}$ admits a generically $2$-to-$1$ rational map onto the projective space $\mathbb{P}^4$.
